title: Extreme high tides expected in San Diego
description:
Extreme high tides are expected along San Diego's coast starting Saturday, July 11, through July 15, and some low-lying coastal areas may see temporary flooding. 

During the high tides, the City's Stormwater Department increases warning signs and deploys additional staff in the Midway neighborhood and other tide‑impacted areas to help keep motorists safe. Teams will also be monitoring low-lying areas in Mission Beach and are prepared to respond if flooding occurs. 

If you live or park in flood‑prone areas, now is a good time to plan ahead: 
• Use sandbags where appropriate. 
• Avoid parking vehicles in areas known to flood. 
• Stay alert for posted signage and changing conditions. 

The City offers free unfilled sandbags for San Diego residents at select recreation centers. Find locations and more preparedness tips on the City's Storm Preparedness page at sandiego.gov/storm-preparedness.
